question: How is the interval between garlands proportioned on the sides of the cage?
premises: The interval between garlands is specified next.
Its measure is given as one part.
The placement is on the two sides of the cage.
inference: The hārāntara on both sides of the paṃjara is set at one part.
plain_english: Then the interval between the garlands on the two sides of the cage is to be one part.
